daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-making particle. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam. ﴿فِتْنَتُهُمْ﴾ its noun (ism), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming (verbal-noun) and accusative-making particle. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of takun: "except their saying". The clause takun is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is a genitive (majrūr) noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "I swear" (أقسم), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رَبِّنا﴾ a badal (substitute) of الله, genitive, and nā is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما كُنَّا﴾ mā is negating. Kāna is an incomplete past verb, nā is its noun, and ﴿مُشْرِكِينَ﴾ is its khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ; the clause mā كنا مشركين is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَذَبُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb انظر. The clause انظر is resumptive. ﴿وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ما كانُوا﴾ ضل is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun mā is its fāʿil; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. It is also permissible to parse mā as maṣdar-forming, it and the verb after it being interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of ضل, i.e. "their fabrication strayed from them".

daas-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; minhum is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun على قلوبهم are attached if جعلنا means "We let down"; or they are attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if جعلنا is one of the verbs of transformation that take two objects, i.e. "We made coverings cast upon their hearts". ﴿أَنْ يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾ an is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-making particle; ﴿يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ is its object.
The interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by a preposition: "so that they do not understand it" (لئلا يفقهوه). It is also said that the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to their understanding it", with a muḍāf omitted. The clause ﴿وَجَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ is conjoined to the nominal clause before it, and the implied clause ﴿جعلنا فِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional particle [Translator's note: the source writes «أن» here, while the word in the verse is «إن»]. ﴿يَرَوْا كُلَّ﴾ the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and kulla is its object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿آيَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُوا بِها﴾ the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; lā is negating, with no grammatical position, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with fāʾ. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive. ﴿جاؤُكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يُجادِلُونَكَ﴾ the verbal clause made up of the imperfect verb, the fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi is likewise in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ الذين is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of the verb before it, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the clause كفروا is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ هذا﴾ in is negating, and dhā is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ. The nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; hum is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ﴾ is its khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿وَيَنْأَوْنَ عَنْهُ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); in is negating. ﴿يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined, and mā is negating.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿وُقِفُوا عَلَى النَّارِ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The apodosis of law is omitted, i.e. "you would have seen a tremendous thing on that day". ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا لَيْتَنا﴾ the yāʾ is for the vocative, the one addressed being omitted, or it is for drawing attention (tanbīh); layta is a particle resembling the verb, and nā is its noun. ﴿نُرَدُّ﴾ a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is "we" (نحن), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of layta. ﴿وَلا نُكَذِّبَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya), lā is negating, nukadhdhiba is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the wāw of accompaniment, and the fāʿil is "we". ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ attached to nukadhdhiba. ﴿رَبِّنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb after it is conjoined to an implied maṣdar, the implied form being: "Would that there were for us a return and a not-denying". ﴿وَنَكُونَ﴾ conjoined to nuraddu. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a preposition. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a genitive (majrūr) noun with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the incomplete verb ﴿نكن﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is «نكون»], whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we".

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿بَدا لَهُمْ ما﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the relative noun mā is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined by the conjunction bal. ﴿كانُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يُخْفُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ qablu is an adverb of time, indeclinable on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of the genitive by min; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخفون, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿وَلَوْ رُدُّوا﴾ ردوا is a passive past verb, the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is resumptive, after the resumptive wāw. The clause ﴿لَعادُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لِما﴾ mā is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عادوا. ﴿نُهُوا عَنْهُ﴾ a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is latent [Translator's note: so in the source], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نهوا; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكاذِبُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction which conjoins the clause وقالوا to the clause ﴿لَعادُوا﴾ or to ﴿نُهُوا عَنْهُ﴾. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating, meaning mā, with no governing effect. ﴿هِيَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿حَياتُنَا﴾ the khabar (predicate). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the clause in hiya إلا حياتنا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِمَبْعُوثِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; مبعوثين is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of mā; the nominal clause is conjoined to the nominal clause before it.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وَلَوْ تَرى إِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of verse 27. ﴿أَلَيْسَ هذا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; laysa is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the demonstrative is in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; الحق is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of laysa; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of answer. ﴿وَرَبِّنا﴾ the wāw is a particle of the genitive and of oath; ربنا is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath "we swear" (نقسم). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition): "since you have been asked and have confessed, then taste the punishment". ذوقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ its object. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and mā is maṣdar-forming. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna, and the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تَكْفُرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as its khabar; mā and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of your disbelief".

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا﴾ الذين is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent), and the clause كذبوا is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ an inceptive particle. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional. ﴿جاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا حَسْرَتَنا﴾ yā is a vocative particle; حسرتا is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf) and accusative, and nā is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلى ما فَرَّطْنا فِيها﴾ فرطنا is a past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حسرة: "O our regret over our neglect in it". ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); hum is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the verbal clause ﴿يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزارَهُمْ عَلى ظُهُورِهِمْ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿ساءَ﴾ a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun explained by what follows it, and ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification), i.e. "evil is their deed as a burden they act upon", and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). It is also possible that ﴿ساءَ ما يَزِرُونَ﴾ is an inflecting verb, with mā a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; or mā is maṣdar-forming, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of the nominative as fāʿil: "evil is their bearing [of burdens]"; or on the assumption of an omitted object: "their bearing [of burdens] grieves them" (ساء هم وزرهم).

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لَعِبٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلَهْوٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلَلدَّارُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the lām is for inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), الدار is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْآخِرَةُ﴾ an adjective. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ the khabar. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) khayr [Translator's note: the source says «متعلقان بخبر», "attached to a khabar"], and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, lā is negating, and the clause تعقلون is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿قَدْ﴾ conveys paucity with the imperfect, but with respect to Allah, multiplicity is meant by it. ﴿نَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb that takes two objects, but it is suspended (muʿallaq) because of the lām of inception in the khabar (predicate) of inna, and for this reason its hamza is given kasra after نعلم. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَيَحْزُنُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, the kāf is its object, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent), and the verbal clause ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause qad نعلم is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ لا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ﴾ يكذبونك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the hāʾ is its noun; the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), and accordingly the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لكِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ its noun, accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿بِآياتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it, ﴿بِآياتِ﴾, are attached (mutaʿalliq); the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of lākinna; the clause wa-lākinna الظالمين is conjoined to what precedes it by the conjunctive wāw.

daas-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and the lām occurs in the answer to the implied oath, i.e. "By Allah, verily were denied"; qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the quiescent tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of rusul; the clause kudhdhibat has no grammatical position because it occurs as the answer to the implied oath.
﴿فَصَبَرُوا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى ما كُذِّبُوا﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming, and it is interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by على; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَأُوذُوا﴾ likewise a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined, so it too is interpreted as a maṣdar, i.e. "they were patient over their being denied and being harmed". ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿أَتاهُمْ نَصْرُنا﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil. ﴿وَلا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِماتِ اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); lā is the lā of generic negation, which governs as inna does. ﴿مُبَدِّلَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿لِكَلِماتِ﴾ the two are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وَلَقَدْ جاءَكَ﴾ a past verb, the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil is omitted, the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْ نَبَإِ﴾ being attached to its adjective, i.e. "some of the news of the messengers has come to you". The clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an implied oath, like the one before it.

daas-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; in is a jussive-making conditional particle. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and its khabar (predicate) is the verbal clause ﴿كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْراضُهُمْ﴾; عليك is attached to (mutaʿalliq) kabura, and the clause in kāna is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); in is conditional; استطعت is a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَنْ تَبْتَغِيَ نَفَقاً﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an, and its object; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied form being "if you are able to seek". ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of nafaq. ﴿أَوْ سُلَّماً فِي السَّماءِ﴾ conjoined to ﴿نَفَقاً فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿فَتَأْتِيَهُمْ بِآيَةٍ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to tabtaghiya, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the hāʾ is its object, its fāʿil is "you", and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "if you are able, then do so". ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى الْهُدى﴾ a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being "he"; the lām occurs in the answer to law, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَلا تَكُونَنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition); lā is the prohibitive, jussive-making lā; تكونن is an incomplete imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis, the nūn being a particle with no grammatical position; it is in the position of the jussive by lā.
﴿مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar of the incomplete verb تكونن, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition: "If you know that, then do not be among the ignorant".

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and a relative noun, its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause إنما يستجيب is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْمَوْتى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الموتى is a noun accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation), by an implied verb explained by what follows it; the implied clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿يَبْعَثُهُمُ﴾ is explicative (mufassira), with no grammatical position. It is also permissible that the wāw is resumptive and ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, and the verbal clause ﴿يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate). ﴿ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause nuzzila is its object. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and āya is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of āya. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and its object is the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ قادِرٌ﴾: الله, the Name of Majesty, is the noun of inna, and قادر is its khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلى أَنْ يُنَزِّلَ آيَةً﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an, and āya is its object; an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the active participle قادر. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); lākinna is a particle resembling the verb, aktharahum is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause wa-lākinna is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وَما مِنْ دَابَّةٍ﴾ a resumptive statement; mā is negating, with no governing effect; min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; دابة is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of دابة. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿طائِرٍ﴾ conjoined to دابة. ﴿يَطِيرُ بِجَناحَيْهِ﴾ جناحيه is a noun genitive by the preposition, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the nūn is dropped because of annexation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يطير, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿إِلَّا أُمَمٌ﴾ إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); umam is the khabar (predicate) of دابة, nominative. ﴿أَمْثالُكُمْ﴾ an adjective. ﴿ما فَرَّطْنا فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, nā is its fāʿil (agent), and mā is negating, with no governing effect; the clause has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, interposed between the two conjoined clauses. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant particle; شيء is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) [Translator's note: so in the source («مرفوع محلا»); a substitute for the absolute object would be accusative in position]. ﴿ثُمَّ إِلى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is conjoined to the clause وما min دابة.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿صُمٌّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَبُكْمٌ﴾ conjoined to صم. ﴿فِي الظُّلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَشَأِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and given kasra to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ its fāʿil, and its object is omitted, the implied form being "whomever Allah wills to lead astray". And ﴿يُضْلِلْهُ﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive; the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is "he", and the clause has no grammatical position, not being joined with fāʾ; the clause يشاء is the khabar of man, and the nominal clause man يشاء الله is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وَمَنْ يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ is conjoined, and the object of يشاء is likewise omitted, i.e. "and whomever He wills to guide, He places him".

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ﴾ i.e. "tell me": the hamza is for interrogation; رأيت is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the tāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); the kāf is a particle of address, and the mīm is for the plural. The two objects of رأيت are omitted, i.e. "Have you considered your gods: will they avail you if the punishment of Allah comes to you?" … and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional, jussive-making. ﴿أَتاكُمْ﴾ a past verb, the kāf is its object, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَذابُ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ conjoined; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of in is omitted, the implied form being: "then whom will you call upon?" ﴿أَغَيْرَ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle; ghayra is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun and the mīm is for the plural, and ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate), accusative with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it: "if you are truthful, then call upon your gods".

daas-irab:41-41.t:
﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿إِيَّاهُ﴾ a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ؟﴾.
﴿فَيَكْشِفُ ما تَدْعُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause yakshifu is conjoined to what precedes it; mā is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause تدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the object of تدعون is omitted, i.e. "what you call upon Him for". The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of ﴿إِنْ شاءَ﴾ is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. ﴿إن شاء فإنه يكشف ما تدعون إليه﴾ ("if He wills, He removes what you call upon Him for"), and the clause is parenthetical. ﴿وَتَنْسَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, i.e. ﴿ما تشركونه﴾ ("what you associate [with Him]").

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, the lām occurs in the answer to the implied oath, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا إِلى أُمَمٍ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); nā is its fāʿil (agent), and its object is omitted: "We sent messengers to nations before you". And ﴿مِنْ﴾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَبْلِكَ﴾ a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as an adverb (ẓarf) of time, and the verbal clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿فَأَخَذْناهُمْ بِالْبَأْساءِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; nā is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object, and the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿وَالضَّرَّاءِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَتَضَرَّعُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as its khabar (predicate); the clause لعلهم يتضرعون is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿فَلَوْلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb تضرعوا after it. ﴿جاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنا﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause ﴿فلولا تضرعوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākin is lightened (mukhaffafa), for rectification (istidrāk). ﴿قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; الشيطان is its fāʿil, and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its object, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ kāna, the wāw is its noun, and the clause يعملون is its khabar (predicate); the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:44-44.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; لما is adverbial. ﴿نَسُوا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما ذُكِّرُوا﴾ mā is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَتَحْنا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and nā is its fāʿil. ﴿أَبْوابَ﴾ its object. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ an inceptive particle. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive, attached to the apodosis أخذناهم.
﴿فَرِحُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to فرحوا, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَخَذْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, nā is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿إِذا﴾ is the إذا of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it is a particle. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُبْلِسُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿فَقُطِعَ دابِرُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; قطع is a passive past verb, ﴿دابِرُ﴾ its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause قطع is conjoined. ﴿وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ الحمد is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty with the preposition are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a badal (substitute) of الله, genitive like it with kasra. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural; the clause ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ "tell me": the hamza is for interrogation; رأيتم is a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent) and the mīm is for the plural. There is disagreement about the two objects of أرأيتم, just as there was disagreement about the two objects of أرأيتكم earlier. It is said that the first is omitted, "Have you considered your hearing", and that the second object is the interrogative clause "who is a god other than Allah?" Perhaps the nearer view, which needs no implied element, is to consider the verb suspended (muʿallaq) from governing because of the interrogation, and that the clause ﴿مَنْ إِلهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ﴾ stands in place of the two objects; the conjoined clauses ﴿إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ﴾ are parenthetical, the clause أرأيتم is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause of saying is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional particle. ﴿أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿وَأَبْصارَكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَخَتَمَ عَلى قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) khatama. ﴿مَنْ إِلهٌ﴾ man is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and إله is its khabar (predicate). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the verse has «اللَّهِ»] the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause ﴿يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ﴾ is a second adjective. ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نُصَرِّفُ الْآياتِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and its fāʿil is "we"; the clause نصرف الآيات is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَصْدِفُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿قُلْ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ﴾ for the i'rab of this, see verse no. 40. ﴿يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and al-qawm is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause stands in place of the two objects of أرأيتكم, or it is its second object, the first being omitted.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, mā is negating. ﴿نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, accusative with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we". ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُبَشِّرِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with yāʾ. ﴿وَمُنْذِرِينَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-making conditional noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause آمن is its khabar (predicate) according to some of them; or it is inceptive, and the two clauses of the protasis and apodosis are the khabar. ﴿وَأَصْلَحَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فَلا خَوْفٌ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); lā is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿خَوْفٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلا هُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَحْزَنُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause ﴿وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾ is conjoined to the clause فلا khawfun, so like it, it is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its object and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, mā is maṣdar-forming, and it and the verb after it, كانوا, are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the preposition, i.e. "because of their transgression"; the clause ﴿يَفْسُقُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); lā is negating, with no governing effect, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb qul; the clause qul is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عِنْدِي خَزائِنُ اللَّهِ﴾ عندي is an adverb (ẓarf) of place, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) خزائن. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ﴾ أعلم is an imperfect verb and its object, lā is negating, and the clause is conjoined to the nominal clause before it; the clause ولا أقول lakum is conjoined to the clause lā أقول before it. ﴿إِنِّي مَلَكٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَتَّبِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, its object. ﴿يُوحى إِلَيَّ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمى﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative with a ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿وَالْبَصِيرُ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿تَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive, or conjoined.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿وَأَنْذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِينَ﴾ andhir is an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the relative noun is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَخافُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْ يُحْشَرُوا إِلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb laysa. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the postponed noun of laysa, ﴿وَلِيٌّ﴾. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿شَفِيعٌ﴾ conjoined to ﴿وَلِيٌّ﴾; the clause of the incomplete verb is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ﴾ لعل and its noun, and the clause يتقون is in the position of the nominative as its khabar; the clause لعلهم يتقون is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وَلا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, given kasra to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", the relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْغَداةِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يدعون. ﴿وَالْعَشِيِّ﴾ conjoined. ﴿يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ﴾ the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما عَلَيْكَ﴾ mā is negating; ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) شيء, and likewise ﴿مِنْ حِسابِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to this omitted khabar.
﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; شيء is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the mubtadaʾ. Some parsed it as the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does, with شيء as its noun and عليك its fronted khabar. ﴿وَما مِنْ حِسابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and the hāʾ is its object; likewise the incomplete imperfect verb ﴿فَتَكُونَ﴾, whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and its khabar is ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾. The clause mā عليك min حسابهم… is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause mā min حسابك is conjoined; the interpreted maṣdar from the fāʾ of causation and the verb تطردهم is conjoined, the implied form being: "Let there not be from you a driving away and a being among the wrongdoers".

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a preposition and dhā is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We tried some of them with a trying that is like that trying"; the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; nā is its fāʿil (agent) and بعضهم its object, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِيَقُولُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl). يقولوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to فتنا. ﴿أَهؤُلاءِ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِنا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ﴾ laysa is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; الله, the Name of Majesty, is its noun; in بأعلم the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and أعلم is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of laysa, genitive with fatḥa instead of kasra, being a diptote because it is descriptive and on the pattern afʿal. ﴿بِالشَّاكِرِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) أعلم. The clause ﴿أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive. ﴿جاءَكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, the kāf is its object, and the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآياتِنا﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ the clause is the answer to إذا, with no grammatical position. ﴿سَلامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى نَفْسِهِ﴾ the two are attached to kataba, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الرَّحْمَةَ﴾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوءاً﴾ is its khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَمِلَ.. سُوءاً﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿مَنْ﴾, according to some of them. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil, and likewise ﴿بِجَهالَةٍ﴾: the two are also attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ تابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, conjoined to آمن [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is «عَمِلَ»]; and like it is the verb ﴿وَأَصْلَحَ﴾, conjoined, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun. ﴿فَأَنَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of man; anna is a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar. Anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "then his outcome is Allah's forgiveness and His mercy".

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative dhā is indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: "We detail the signs with a clear detailing, like that detailing". ﴿نُفَصِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the fāʿil (agent) is "we", and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl); تستبين is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to an implied preposition and genitive noun before them, attached to ﴿بنفصل﴾, the implied form being: "We detail the signs so that the truth may become clear". ﴿وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ تستبين is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied an after the lām of cause. ﴿سَبِيلُ﴾ the fāʿil. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:56-56.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿نُهِيتُ﴾ a passive past verb, the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿أَنْ أَعْبُدَ﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an; an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by an implied (muqaddar) preposition, i.e. "I have been forbidden from worshipping", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb نهيت. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿لا أَتَّبِعُ أَهْواءَكُمْ﴾ the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of answer and requital, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿أَنَا﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is conjoined. It is also possible to parse ﴿ما﴾ as the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does, with ﴿أَنَا﴾ as its noun and the preposition and its genitive noun attached to its khabar.

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ a noun genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position [of the genitive] by annexation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿بَيِّنَةٍ﴾. ﴿وَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِهِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of circumstance. ﴿ما عِنْدِي﴾ mā is negating; ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time [Translator's note: so in the source; عند is normally classed as an adverb of place], accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿ما تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar is the adverb عندي. The verbal clause تستعجلون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِ﴾ negating, meaning mā. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to its omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); huwa is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْفاصِلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time [Translator's note: so in the source; عند is normally classed as an adverb of place], accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of anna [Translator's note: the source skips «أَنَّ» of the verse («لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدِي») in its quoted words]. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna [Translator's note: so in the source («اسم إن»); the particle in the verse is «أَنَّ»]. ﴿تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb: "if their hastening were established…"; the clause law and what follows it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي﴾ a passive imperfect verb [Translator's note: so in the source; «قُضِيَ» is a past verb] and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾ an adverb of place, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِالظَّالِمِينَ﴾ are attached to it; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿وَعِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَفاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: so in the source, which labels the pair this way; مفاتح is the postponed mubtadaʾ just mentioned, and al-ghaybi is the muḍāf ilayhi], and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the hāʾ is its object, and lā is negating. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the verb يعلمها, or it is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما فِي الْبَرِّ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [element forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; waraqa is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position because it is the fāʿil of ﴿تَسْقُطُ﴾. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿يَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the clause is a ḥāl of waraqa; this is allowed because it is preceded by a negation. ﴿وَلا حَبَّةٍ﴾ conjoined, and lā is negating. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of حب. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا رَطْبٍ﴾ conjoined to حب. ﴿وَلا يابِسٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) of His words ﴿إِلَّا يَعْلَمُها﴾. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate). ﴿يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the mīm is for the plural, and the fāʿil (agent) refers back to the relative noun. ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", and the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهارِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِيُقْضى أَجَلٌ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl), the sign of its accusative being a fatḥa implied on the alif; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb ﴿يَبْعَثُكُمْ﴾. ﴿أَجَلٌ﴾ the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of ajal. ﴿ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ ilayhi: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ مرجعكم, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it; likewise the clause ﴿ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ after it is conjoined. ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of kuntum.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الْقاهِرُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the active participle القاهر. ﴿عِبادِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; حفظة is its object and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, and the clause is conjoined to the nominal clause before it. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional. ﴿جاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ﴾ a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil. ﴿تَوَفَّتْهُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the omitted alif; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رُسُلُنا﴾ the fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُمْ لا يُفَرِّطُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); hum is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يُفَرِّطُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause ﴿هُمْ لا يُفَرِّطُونَ﴾ is circumstantial or resumptive.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿ثُمَّ رُدُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنا﴾. ﴿مَوْلاهُمُ﴾ a badal (substitute) of الله, genitive like it with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its appearance prevented by impossibility; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of مولى, genitive like it with kasra. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention and opening (tanbīh wa-istiftāḥ). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; likewise the nominal clause ﴿وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ الْحاسِبِينَ﴾ is resumptive like it.

daas-irab:63-64.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْ ظُلُماتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الْبَرِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿تَدْعُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object. ﴿تَضَرُّعاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَخُفْيَةً﴾ conjoined, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿لَئِنْ أَنْجانا﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); ﴿إن﴾ a jussive-making conditional particle. ﴿أَنْجانا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa, and nā is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The clause is the object of an omitted saying, its implied form being: "you call upon Him and say: if He saves us"; it may also be inceptive, since it is the conditional clause. ﴿مِنْ هذِهِ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿لَنَكُونَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; نكونن is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because of its connection with the nūn of emphasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we". ﴿مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of in has been omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it, according to the rule: when an oath and a condition come together, the answer belongs to the one that comes first. ﴿قُلِ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُنَجِّيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْها﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَمِنْ كُلِّ﴾ conjoined. ﴿كَرْبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ the mubtadaʾ. ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:65-65.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil (agent) is latent, and the nominal clause ﴿هُوَ الْقادِرُ﴾, made up of the mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أَنْ﴾ and the verb ﴿يَبْعَثَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by على. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عَذاباً﴾. ﴿أَوْ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its object. ﴿شِيَعاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿يَبْعَثَ﴾. ﴿وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first object, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿بَأْسَ﴾ its second object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿نُصَرِّفُ الْآياتِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and its fāʿil is "you" [Translator's note: so in the source («أنت»); the verb is first person plural, "we"]; the verbal clause stands in place of the two objects of انظر, and the clause ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعل, and the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative as its noun, and the clause ﴿يَفْقَهُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as its khabar; the nominal clause لعلهم يفقهون is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:66-66.t:
﴿وَكَذَّبَ بِهِ قَوْمُكَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); qawmuka is its fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); the verbal clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive.
﴿لَسْتُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to وكيل. ﴿بِوَكِيلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition in the khabar of lastu; وكيل is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of lastu, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:67-67.t: ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿نَبَإٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُسْتَقَرٌّ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَسَوْفَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and sawfa is a particle of the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). The two clauses are resumptive.

daas-irab:68-68.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) containing the meaning of condition. ﴿رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent) and the relative noun its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation after the adverb إذا. ﴿يَخُوضُونَ فِي آياتِنا﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿يَخُوضُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; likewise ﴿فِي حَدِيثٍ﴾ is attached to the verb يخوضوا before them. ﴿غَيْرِهِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَإِمَّا﴾ in is a jussive-making conditional particle that makes two imperfect verbs jussive; mā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿يُنْسِيَنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا تَقْعُدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, to which the adverb ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ is attached; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿الذِّكْرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to تقعد. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an adjective, genitive with yāʾ.

daas-irab:69-69.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, mā is negating. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) شيء. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ حِسابِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيء, because it has come before it after having been its adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, and the khabar is omitted, the implied form being: "but upon them is a reminder"; this is easier than assuming an omitted verb:
"remind them a reminding". ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعل, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar. The nominal clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:70-70.t: ﴿وَذَرِ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn and given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the fāʿil (agent) is "you", and the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object, and ﴿لَعِباً﴾ its second object. ﴿وَلَهْواً﴾ conjoined, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَياةُ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَذَكِّرْ بِهِ﴾ also conjoined. ﴿أَنْ تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, the implied form being: "so that [a soul] is not given up to destruction" (لئلا تبسل). ﴿بِما كَسَبَتْ﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming, and it is interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb tubsala, the implied form being "that it be given up to destruction for its earning". ﴿لَيْسَ لَها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb laysa. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ولي or شفيع. ﴿وَلِيٌّ﴾ the noun of laysa, nominative. ﴿وَلا شَفِيعٌ﴾ conjoined, and the clause of the incomplete verb is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of nafs. ﴿وَإِنْ تَعْدِلْ﴾ in is conditional and تعدل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil being a latent pronoun. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿عَدْلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْها﴾ the clause of the passive imperfect verb is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun; منها is attached to the verb before it, and lā is negating; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with fāʾ or with conditional إذا; the clause in تعدل is conjoined. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar. ﴿أُبْسِلُوا﴾ a passive past verb, the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما كَسَبُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar composed of maṣdar-forming mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the clause كسبوا is the ṣila. ﴿لَهُمْ شَرابٌ﴾ lahum is attached to a fronted khabar, and شراب is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ حَمِيمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of شراب. ﴿وَعَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾ conjoined. ﴿بِما كانُوا يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عذاب or to an omitted adjective: "for them is a punishment for their disbelief". The clause lahum عذاب is a second khabar of the demonstrative أولئك.

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَدْعُوا مِنْ دُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw because of heaviness, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا يَنْفَعُنا﴾ an imperfect verb, nā is its object and its fāʿil (agent) is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا يَضُرُّنا﴾ conjoined; the clause أندعو is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَنُرَدُّ عَلى أَعْقابِنا﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "we", and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿أَنَدْعُوا﴾. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time attached to nuraddu. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿هَدانَا اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿كَالَّذِي﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "we are turned back with a turning like the turning of the one whom the devils enticed", and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation; or the kāf is a preposition and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the two are attached to an omitted adjective of the mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿اسْتَهْوَتْهُ الشَّياطِينُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on a fatḥa implied on the omitted alif; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and الشياطين is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿حَيْرانَ﴾ a ḥāl. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَصْحابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the verbal clause ﴿يَدْعُونَهُ إِلَى الْهُدَى﴾ is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of أصحاب. ﴿ائْتِنا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter from its end, because it is weak-final (أتى); its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and nā is its object; the clause is the object of the saying of an omitted verb, its implied form being "saying: come to us", and the implied clause is circumstantial; the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ﴾ inna and its noun, and الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْهُدَى﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause ﴿هُوَ الْهُدى﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna; the clause inna هدى الله is the object of the saying. ﴿وَأُمِرْنا﴾ a passive past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and nā is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause inna هدى الله. ﴿لِنُسْلِمَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb وأمرنا: "we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds". ﴿لِرَبِّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb nuslima. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb after it is conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar from nuslima and the an before it, the implied form being: "we have been commanded to submit and to establish the prayer".
﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَاتَّقُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; huwa is a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative noun ﴿الَّذِي﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb after them. ﴿تُحْشَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:73-73.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive; the clause ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "He created the heavens, [it being] determined with truth". ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time attached to the omitted verb ﴿اذكر﴾ ("remember"), and the verbal clause is resumptive; the clause ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿كُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", referring to everything Allah created. ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾ a complete imperfect verb conjoined to the verb kun before it, and the two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, a badal (substitute) of yawma يقول before it, accusative with fatḥa like it. ﴿يُنْفَخُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي الصُّورِ﴾ are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿عالِمُ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He is the Knower". ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالشَّهادَةِ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْخَبِيرُ﴾ a second khabar, nominative.

daas-irab:74-74.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "remember" (اذكر); the wāw is resumptive, so the clause is resumptive, and the verbal clause ﴿قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿آزَرَ﴾ a badal (substitute), genitive with fatḥa in place of kasra because it is a proper name and foreign. ﴿أَتَتَّخِذُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿أَصْناماً﴾ its first object. ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ its second object; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿إِنِّي أَراكَ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿أَراكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the kāf is its first object; في ضلال is attached to أراك and the two are the second object; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I". ﴿وَقَوْمَكَ﴾ a noun conjoined to the kāf, accusative with fatḥa, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with kasra. The clause أراك is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
