daas-irab:75-75.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an implied maṣdar, the implied form being: "We show Ibrāhīm the dominion of the heavens and the earth with a showing like the showing of his father's error"; the wāw before them is parenthetical. ﴿نُرِي إِبْراهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "we"; Ibrāhīm is its first object and ملكوت its second object. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَلِيَكُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the incomplete verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to an implied, omitted conjoined element, i.e. "We did that so that he would believe and so that he would be certain". ﴿مِنَ الْمُوقِنِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون. The clause ﴿وَكَذلِكَ نُرِي..﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is adverbial, of time (ḥīniyya). ﴿جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and al-layl is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿رَأى كَوْكَباً﴾ a past verb and its object, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to conditional لما; the clause ﴿قالَ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هذا﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبِّي﴾ the khabar (predicate), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَلَمَّا أَفَلَ﴾ like ﴿فَلَمَّا جَنَّ﴾. The clause ﴿قالَ﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿لا أُحِبُّ الْآفِلِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, accusative with yāʾ, and the clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا رَأَى الْقَمَرَ﴾ the i'rab of its like has preceded, and likewise ﴿قالَ هذا رَبِّي فَلَمَّا أَفَلَ قالَ..﴾. ﴿بازِغاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, because رأى is visual, not mental. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-making particle. ﴿يَهْدِنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبِّي﴾ the fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَأَكُونَنَّ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis; the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath that preceded the condition, so it stands in place of its apodosis. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb. ﴿الضَّالِّينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with yāʾ.

daas-irab:78-78.t: The i'rab of the beginning of the verse has preceded. ﴿هذا أَكْبَرُ﴾ like هذا ربي in the previous verse. ﴿مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ mā: maṣdar-forming, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ببريء﴾, the implied form being "I am free of your associating"; it may also be a relative noun, i.e. "of those you associate with Allah"; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) on the first view and the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun on the second. [Translator's note: so in the source; on the first view, maṣdar-forming mā and its clause would form a maṣdar rather than an adjective.]

daas-irab:79-79.t: ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿وَجَّهْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَجْهِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿لِلَّذِي﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فَطَرَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿حَنِيفاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negating, with no governing effect, or it is the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does. ﴿أَنَا﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ — this on the first view in the i'rab of mā — and the clause is conjoined; the clause ﴿إِنِّي﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the verbal clause ﴿وَجَّهْتُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وَحاجَّهُ قَوْمُهُ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَتُحاجُّونِّي﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; تحاجوني is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the [second] nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿هَدانِ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا أَخافُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, lā is negating, أخاف is an imperfect verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I", and the clause is resumptive. ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ يَشاءَ﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ the fāʿil, nominative with a ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb after it is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, the implied form being: "but my Lord's will, I fear it". ﴿وَسِعَ رَبِّي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and شيء is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿عِلْماً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿أَفَلا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; lā is negating, the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is resumptive; the clause ﴿تَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:81-81.t:
﴿وَكَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَشْرَكْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَخافُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil and lā is negating; the clause is conjoined, or circumstantial if the wāw before it is circumstantial. ﴿أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُمْ﴾ anna, and the kāf is its noun, and the clause ashraktum is its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them.
﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَيُّ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition); ayyu is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْفَرِيقَيْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾ the khabar. ﴿بِالْأَمْنِ﴾ the two are attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) أحق. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ kāna is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun and the clause تعلمون is its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it: "if you know, then tell me: which of the two parties is more deserving of security?" The clause ayyu الفريقين is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:82-82.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause الذين آمنوا is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil (agent) and its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْأَمْنُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لَهُمُ الْأَمْنُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك lahumu al-amnu is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the relative noun الذين. ﴿وَهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of circumstance. This is if the speech is the speech of Allah the Exalted; if it is the speech of our master Ibrāhīm, the i'rab differs from this, and الذين is parsed as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "the more deserving of security are those who believed".

daas-irab:83-83.t: ﴿وَتِلْكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and [تي is] a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿حُجَّتُنا﴾ the khabar (predicate), and nā is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿آتَيْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); the nominal clause wa-tilka حجتنا is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) حجة. ﴿نَرْفَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we". ﴿دَرَجاتٍ﴾ a ḥāl, accusative with kasra instead of fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause نرفع is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:84-84.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنا لَهُ إِسْحاقَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); nā is its fāʿil (agent) and الحق is its object [Translator's note: so in the source («والحق مفعوله»), evidently for «إسحاق», Isḥāq]. ﴿وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كُلًّا﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb after it. ﴿هَدَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَنُوحاً هَدَيْنا﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi, a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "and We guided them, they being of his offspring". And ﴿داوُدَ وَسُلَيْمانَ﴾ are conjoined to Nūḥ. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a preposition; dhā is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "We reward the good-doers with a reward like that reward". ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we"; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:85-85.t: ﴿وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيى وَعِيسى وَإِلْياسَ﴾ conjoined to Mūsā and Hārūn. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; beginning with an indefinite is permitted because of the implied annexation in it: "and every man of them". ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ a noun genitive with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause ﴿كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ is parenthetical.

daas-irab:86-86.t: ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطاً﴾ conjoined to Ilyās. ﴿وَكلًّا﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿فَضَّلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the clause is conjoined to the clause kullan هدينا.

daas-irab:87-87.t: ﴿وَمِنْ آبائِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to Dāwūd and Sulaymān, i.e. "and Nūḥ We guided before, and of his offspring Dāwūd and Sulaymān". ﴿وَمِنْ آبائِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ وَإِخْوانِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاجْتَبَيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and like it ﴿وَهَدَيْناهُمْ﴾. ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾ إلى صراط: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the two clauses are conjoined to the clause ﴿وَكلًّا فَضَّلْنا﴾.

daas-irab:88-88.t:
﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿هُدَى﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and man is a relative noun, its object. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being of His servants"; the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَهْدِي بِهِ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of هدى الله. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ law is a non-jussive conditional particle and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَشْرَكُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil of حبط; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. It is also possible that ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, the maṣdar interpreted from it and the verb after it being in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, the implied form being: "their work would have come to nothing for them".
﴿كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw is its noun and the clause يعملون is its khabar; the clause of the incomplete verb is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, on the parsing of ﴿ما﴾ as a relative noun.

daas-irab:89-89.t:
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, its khabar (predicate). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ﴾ conjoined; the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause أولئك الذين is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and in is a jussive-making conditional particle that makes two imperfect verbs jussive.
﴿يَكْفُرْ بِها هؤُلاءِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the demonstrative هؤلاء is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ [qad is] a particle of realization (taḥqīq), and the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَكَّلْنا بِها قَوْماً﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; nā is its fāʿil and qawman its object, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لَيْسُوا بِها بِكافِرِينَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw is its noun; in بكافرين the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and كافرين is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of laysa. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to the active participle ﴿كافرين﴾, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿قَوْماً﴾.

daas-irab:90-90.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), as in the previous verse, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هَدَى اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being "Allah guided them". ﴿فَبِهُداهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb iqtadih after them. ﴿اقْتَدِهْ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and the hāʾ is for pausing (hāʾ al-sakt); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition: "if the matter is as mentioned, then follow them". ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is "you", and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is "I"; the kāf is its first object, lā is negating, with no governing effect, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿أَجْراً﴾, and ﴿أَجْراً﴾ is its second object. ﴿إِنْ﴾ the negating in. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ the khabar. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to ذكرى, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:91-91.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, mā is negating. ﴿قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَقَّ﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿قَدْرِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb قدروا. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, and mā is negating; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى بَشَرٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; شيء is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the word in the verse is «مَنْ»] an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause anzala is its khabar (predicate). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿جاءَ بِهِ مُوسى﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and Mūsā is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿نُوراً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُدىً﴾ conjoined. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to hudan. ﴿تَجْعَلُونَهُ قَراطِيسَ﴾ an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; قراطيس is a ḥāl, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of الكتاب. ﴿تُبْدُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of قراطيس; the clause ﴿وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيراً﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَعُلِّمْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw before it. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿آباؤُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to antum; the clause تعلموا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the verse has «اللَّهُ»] the Name of Majesty, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: "Allah sent it down"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿ذَرْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, the mīm being the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿فِي خَوْضِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them or after them, and the clause is conjoined; the clause ﴿يَلْعَبُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ الحمد: mubtadaʾ (subject); لله: the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām, [the two] attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive as an adjective of الله; and the clause ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿وَجَعَلَ الظُّلُماتِ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause ﴿يَعْدِلُونَ﴾. ﴿ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ the clause كفروا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ attached to كفروا or to يعدلون, i.e. «they set up others as equal to their Lord»; and the clause ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ .. is conjoined to the clause الحمد لله..

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the kāf is its object; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ قَضى أَجَلًا﴾ past verb and its object; and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَجَلٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. أجل: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ an adjective, nominative with the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَمْتَرُونَ﴾ imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. And the clause أنتم تمترون is conjoined to the clause before it.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its khabar (predicate), nominative. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, by construing it as a derived word (mushtaqq), i.e. «the One worshipped». ﴿وَفِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined; and the nominal clause هو الله is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ﴾ imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «he»; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or in the position of nominative as a second khabar. ﴿وَجَهْرَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to سركم. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما تَكْسِبُونَ﴾ ما: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause تكسبون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ويعلم is conjoined.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وَما تَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ما is negating. ﴿مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. آية: a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, as fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ آياتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of آية. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and the verbal clause تأتيهم is resumptive, after the wāw. And the clause ﴿كانُوا عَنْها مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَمَّا جاءَهُمْ﴾ لما: an adverb of time (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; and the clause جاءهم is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ سوف: a particle of futurity; يأتيهم: imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنْباءُ﴾ fāʿil, nominative. ﴿ما كانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ ما: a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause يستهزئون is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿أَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; يروا: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿كَمْ﴾ declarative (khabariyya), indicating abundance, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أهلكنا; and it has been said: interrogative, indeclinable on the sukūn. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَرْنٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. قرن: a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, as the tamyīz (specification) of كم; and the clause كم أهلكنا stands in place of the two objects of يروا, or its single object if يروا is [the verb] of sight. ﴿مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; نا is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; and the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of قرن. ﴿ما لَمْ نُمَكِّنْ لَكُمْ﴾ ما: a complete (tāmma) indefinite noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. «We established them with some establishing»; and the better i'rab is that it is a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun): «We established them in the land with the establishing with which We have not established you». نمكن: imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, on the second view. ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَا السَّماءَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِدْراراً﴾ أرسلنا: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun عليهم are attached; نا is its fāʿil and السماء its object; مدرارا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is conjoined to the clause مكناهم. ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا الْأَنْهارَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; and the clause ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl if جعلنا takes one object, and in the position of accusative as a second direct object if it takes two objects. The clause ﴿فَأَهْلَكْناهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿مَكَّنَّاهُمْ﴾, and similarly the clause ﴿وَأَنْشَأْنا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْناً﴾ is conjoined. ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾ an adjective, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. لو: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿نَزَّلْنا عَلَيْكَ كِتاباً﴾ نزلنا: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil (agent) and كتابا its object. ﴿فِي قِرْطاسٍ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of كتاب. And the verbal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ لمسوه: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿نَزَّلْنا﴾. ﴿لَقالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ قال: past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), so the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the verbal clause كفروا has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنْ هذا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ﴾ هذا سحر: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); إن is negating and إلا a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:8-8.t: In the verse there are two active verbs, with their fāʿils (agents), namely: قالوا and أنزلنا; and three passive verbs, with their nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent): أنزل ملك، قضي الأمر، ينظرون. The clause قالوا is resumptive (mustaʾnafa); the clause أنزل after it is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause أنزلنا is likewise resumptive. The clause لقضى is the response to لولا [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the verse that this clause answers is لو], with no grammatical position; and the clause ينظرون is conjoined to it.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وَلَوْ جَعَلْناهُ مَلَكاً﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. جعلنا: past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; نا is its fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ its first object and ملكا its second object; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). The clause ﴿لَجَعَلْناهُ رَجُلًا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلَلَبَسْنا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما يَلْبِسُونَ﴾ ما: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the verbal clause يلبسون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَقَدِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. The lām occurs in the response to an implied oath. قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ﴾ past verb, passive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of رسل; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَحاقَ بِالَّذِينَ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun بالذين are attached. ﴿سَخِرُوا﴾ past verb; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to سخروا. ﴿ما﴾ the relative noun, fāʿil (agent) of حاق. ﴿كانُوا بِهِ﴾ the clause كانوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. And the preposition and its genitive noun به are attached to the verb يستهزئون.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and likewise ﴿ثُمَّ انْظُرُوا﴾; the clause سيروا is the speech reported by «say» (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause انظروا is conjoined. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of the verb كان. And ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾ is its noun. ﴿الْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a masculine plural. And the clause ﴿كَيْفَ كانَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb انظروا.

daas-irab:92-92.t: ﴿وَهذا﴾ the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كِتابٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as a first adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مُبارَكٌ﴾ a second adjective. ﴿مُصَدِّقُ﴾ a third adjective. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [element forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَلِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرى﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl); the fāʿil is "you", umm is the mafʿūl bihi, and القرى is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, i.e. "and for warning the Mother of Towns". ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to umm. ﴿حَوْلَها﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted [element forming the] ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ after it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ﴾ is its khabar. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿عَلى صَلاتِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb يحافظون after them, and the clause ﴿يُحافِظُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ hum; the nominal clause ﴿هم يحافظون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:93-93.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) أظلم. ﴿افْتَرى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; kadhiban is its object and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ قالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ﴾ a passive past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and شيء is its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ قالَ﴾ conjoined to mimman, i.e. "and than one who said". ﴿سَأُنْزِلُ مِثْلَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the sīn being for the future, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "Allah sent it down". ﴿وَلَوْ تَرى﴾ the wāw is resumptive; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿إِذِ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time attached to the verb ترى. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative with wāw. ﴿فِي غَمَراتِ الْمَوْتِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and the khabar of law [Translator's note: so in the source («وخبر لو»); what is meant is the answer (jawāb) of law] is omitted, the implied form being: "if you were to see them when the wrongdoers are in the throes of death, you would see a terrible thing". ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿باسِطُوا﴾ the khabar, nominative with wāw. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿أَخْرِجُوا أَنْفُسَكُمُ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e. "saying to them". ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the verb tujzawna after it, or to the verb أخرجوا before it. ﴿تُجْزَوْنَ عَذابَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil and عذاب its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation [Translator's note: so in the source]. ﴿الْهُونِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ تَقُولُونَ﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming, and it is interpreted together with the incomplete verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "you are recompensed with the punishment of humiliation because of your saying". ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ﴾ ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَنْ آياتِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb تستكبرون, and the clause ﴿تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of the incomplete verb, and likewise the clause ﴿تَقُولُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:94-94.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer to the implied oath, qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْتُمُونا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because of its connection with the vowelled tāʾ of the agent; the mīm is for the masculine plural, nā is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is for lengthening the ḍamma. ﴿فُرادى﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition, mā is maṣdar-forming. ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; nā is the fāʿil (agent), the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is for the plural. The interpreted maṣdar from maṣdar-forming mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being "you have come to Us with a coming like Our creating you the first time". ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time attached to the verb before it. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَرَكْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn because of its connection with the tāʾ of the agent; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَوَّلْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, nā is its fāʿil and the kāf its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَراءَ﴾ an adverb attached to the verb before it. ﴿ظُهُورِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما نَرى مَعَكُمْ شُفَعاءَكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the adverb after it is attached; its fāʿil is "we" and شفعاء is its object, and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿كَما خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿زَعَمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكاءُ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; anna and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of زعم. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the position of the answer to the implied oath; ﴿قد﴾ a particle of realization. ﴿تَقَطَّعَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is implied (muqaddar) as "the bond" (al-waṣl). ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to the verb تقطع. ﴿وَضَلَّ عَنْكُمْ ما﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun is its object [Translator's note: so in the source («مفعوله»); mā here is the fāʿil of ضل]; the clause is conjoined.
﴿كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun and the clause تزعمون is its khabar; the two objects of تزعمون are omitted, the implied form being: "what you used to claim to be intercessors has strayed from you".

daas-irab:95-95.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ فالِقُ الْحَبِّ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْحَبِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالنَّوى﴾ conjoined. ﴿يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and الحي is its object; the clause is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar. ﴿وَمُخْرِجُ﴾ conjoined to فالق. ﴿الْمَيِّتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْحَيِّ﴾ the two are attached to the active participle mukhrij. ﴿ذلِكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty is the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition): "if Allah is the one who splits the grain and brings out the dead, then how are you turned away from worshipping Him?" ﴿أنى﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, or it is resumptive.

daas-irab:96-96.t:
﴿فالِقُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "Allah is the one who splits…". ﴿الْإِصْباحِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَكَناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to the nominal clause. ﴿وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined to al-layl. ﴿حُسْباناً﴾ the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "He made it a reckoning". ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَقْدِيرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعَلِيمِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).
The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause ﴿فالِقُ الْإِصْباحِ﴾.

daas-irab:97-97.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, its khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَعَلَ لَكُمُ النُّجُومَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and النجوم is its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِتَهْتَدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb جعل, i.e. "He made the stars for you for being guided by them". ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to تهتدوا. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "that you may be guided by them, travelling in the darknesses of" ﴿الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ﴾. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿فَصَّلْنَا الْآياتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with kasra in place of fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to فصلنا. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause qad فصلنا is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:98-98.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil (agent) is latent and the kāf is its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿واحِدَةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "so for you there is a place of settlement". ﴿وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab in the previous verse.

daas-irab:99-99.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً﴾ the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا بِهِ نَباتَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); nā is its fāʿil (agent) and نبات its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا مِنْهُ خَضِراً﴾ the verbal clause is conjoined. ﴿نُخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّا مُتَراكِباً﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil is "we", حبا is its object and متراكبا an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of خضرا. ﴿وَمِنَ النَّخْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the wāw is parenthetical. ﴿مِنْ طَلْعِها﴾ a badal (substitute) of al-nakhl, a substitute of part for whole. ﴿قِنْوانٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿دانِيَةٌ﴾ an adjective, and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being parenthetical. ﴿وَجَنَّاتٍ﴾ conjoined to نبات. ﴿مِنْ أَعْنابٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of جنات. ﴿وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالرُّمَّانَ﴾ conjoined to جنات. ﴿مُشْتَبِهاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَغَيْرَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مُتَشابِهٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with kasra. ﴿انْظُرُوا إِلى ثَمَرِهِ﴾ an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to the verb before it; it is also permissible that إذا is conditional, its answer omitted, indicated by what precedes it; on both views the clause ﴿أَثْمَرَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَيَنْعِهِ﴾ conjoined to thamarihi. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of inna. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the noun of inna, accusative with kasra in place of fatḥa, [being] a sound feminine plural; the lām is the inceptive lām, for emphasis. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of آيات. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of qawm, and the clause inna في ذلكم is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:100-100.t:
﴿وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of جعل, which is ﴿شُرَكاءَ﴾, and ﴿الْجِنَّ﴾ is its first object, i.e. "they made the jinn partners to Allah"; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَخَلَقَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَخَرَقُوا لَهُ بَنِينَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خرقوا. ﴿وَبَناتٍ﴾ conjoined to بنين, accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of خرقوا.
﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative with fatḥa, and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَتَعالى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil is not overt in the verse]; the clause is conjoined to the implied clause: "Allah sent it down, glory be to Him and exalted is He" [Translator's note: so in the source («أنزله الله سبحانه وتعالى»)], so like it, it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming, and it is interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb تعالى, the implied form being "exalted is He above their describing"; mā may also be a relative noun.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the lām is a preposition and من an interrogative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; and the nominal clause is the speech reported by «say» (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿قُلْ لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām; [the two] are attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «it is Allah's»; the implied nominal clause is the speech reported by «say»; and the clause قل لله is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَتَبَ عَلى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to Allah, and الرحمة is its object; and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; يجمعن: imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis; the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil is a latent pronoun implied as «he», referring to Allah; the mīm is for the masculine plural; and the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ﴾ the lā of generic negation and its noun. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ attached to the khabar. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَسِرُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ direct object. ﴿فَهُمْ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ the fāʾ in it is redundant (zāʾida); هم is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause يؤمنون is in the position of nominative as its khabar; the clause الذين خسروا is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the clause هم لا يؤمنون is the khabar of الذين.

daas-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وَلَهُ﴾ the wāw is conjunctive; له is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما سَكَنَ فِي اللَّيْلِ﴾ سكن: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ما. ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ second khabar.

daas-irab:14-14.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «you». ﴿أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; غير is the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the imperfect verb ﴿أَتَّخِذُ﴾, and الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا﴾ وليا: second direct object, accusative with the fatḥa; the clause أتخذ is the speech reported by «say» (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause قل is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فاطِرِ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of, or a badal (substitute) from, الله. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and the verbal clause ﴿يُطْعِمُ﴾ is in the position of nominative as its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلا يُطْعَمُ﴾ the wāw is conjunctive and لا negating; يطعم: imperfect verb, passive, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir); and the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ﴾ إنّ: a particle resembling the verb, and the yāʾ is its noun. أمرت: past verb, passive, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ; and the clause إني أمرت is the speech reported by «say». ﴿أَنْ أَكُونَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by أن; أن and the defective verb are interpretable as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by a preposition: «and I was commanded to be»; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أمرت. ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ khabar of أكون, whose noun is a latent pronoun implied as «I». ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَسْلَمَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَكُونَنَّ﴾ the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive, governing the jussive.
تكونن: a defective imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive by لا; and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ are attached to an omitted khabar of تكونن; and the clause is the speech reported by an omitted verb, its implied form being: «and it was said to me: do not be of the polytheists».

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ a third imperative verb, in reply to the unbelievers. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿أخاف عذاب﴾ imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «I». ﴿إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي﴾ إن: a jussive conditional particle. عصيت: past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil; and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The clause ﴿إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذابَ﴾ is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the verb and its object; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it: «if I disobey my Lord, then I fear the punishment». ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ an adjective of يوم, genitive like it.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ﴾ imperfect verb, passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «it», referring to the punishment. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ يوم is an adverb of time; إذ is an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, given a kasra to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters; its tanwīn is the tanwīn of compensation for an omitted clause, i.e. «the day the punishment comes to them». ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿رَحِمَهُ﴾ past verb and its object, its fāʿil (agent) latent; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. And the clause ﴿يُصْرَفْ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ according to some of them. ﴿ذلِكَ الْفَوْزُ﴾ the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ an adjective of الفوز.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ إن is conditional. ﴿يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ﴾ imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by إن because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to it; الله, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its object; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿كاشِفَ لَهُ﴾ the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative, to which the preposition and its genitive noun له are attached; the khabar (predicate) of لا is omitted, its implied form being «existing»; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the position of the noun of لا, or a badal from the position of لا with its noun. And the apodosis of ﴿إِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ﴾ is omitted, its implied form being: «then there is none to repel it»; then comes the reason for all of that: ﴿فَهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ هو is mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun على كل are attached to the khabar قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and قدير is the khabar.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. هو: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْقاهِرُ﴾ khabar (predicate), to which the adverb ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ after it is attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿عِبادِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa); and the clause ﴿وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ﴾ is conjoined to it: هو is mubtadaʾ, and الحكيم and الخبير are its two khabars.

daas-irab:19-19.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَيُّ شَيْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهادَةً﴾ أي: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); أكبر: its khabar (predicate). شهادة: tamyīz (specification), accusative; and the clause is the speech reported by «say» (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلِ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. شهيد: its khabar, to which the adverb بيني is attached (mutaʿalliq); it is an adverb, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; and بينكم is conjoined. ﴿وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هذَا الْقُرْآنُ﴾ أوحي: past verb, passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). القرآن: badal (substitute); and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِأُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهِ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl). أنذر: imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb after it is in the position of genitive by the lām; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أوحي: «it was revealed to me for warning you». ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to أنذركم. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is conjunctive; من: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, conjoined to the kāf, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) in أنذركم, i.e. «that I may warn you and warn whomever this Quran reaches»; and the clause ﴿بَلَغَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation. إنّ, and the kāf is its noun; the clause تشهدون is in the position of nominative as its khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and the clause is resumptive.
﴿أَنَّ مَعَ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً أُخْرى﴾ مع: an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar of أنّ; ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ its noun. ﴿أُخْرى﴾ an adjective, accusative. And أنّ with what follows it is interpretable as a maṣdar which stands in place of the two objects of تشهدون. ﴿قُلْ﴾ imperative, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿لا أَشْهَدُ﴾ the clause is the speech reported by «say». ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما هُوَ إِلهٌ واحِدٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and واحد is an adjective; إنما is the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); and the clause is the speech reported by «say». ﴿وَإِنَّنِي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ بريء: khabar of إنّ, and the yāʾ is its noun; ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and the interpreted maṣdar from it and the verb after it is in the position of genitive by من: «and I am free of your associating [partners]»; it is also possible for ما to be relative: «free of that which you associate with Him», the clause being the ṣila of the relative noun, or an adjective of the maṣdar-forming ما [Translator's note: so in the source; with the maṣdariyya parsing the clause is its ṣila]. And the clause وإنني is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ الْكِتابَ﴾ آتينا: past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; نا is its fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ its first object and الكتاب its second object; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَعْرِفُونَهُ﴾ imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; and the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَما يَعْرِفُونَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); يعرفون: imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أَبْناءَهُمُ﴾ its object; ما and the verb after it are interpretable as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the kāf; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: «they know him with a knowing like their knowing of their sons». ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, or as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ: «they are those who»; and the clause ﴿خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَهُمْ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), because of the resemblance to a condition in the relative noun; هم is mubtadaʾ and the clause يؤمنون its khabar; and the clause فهم لا يؤمنون is the khabar of the relative noun.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من: an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾ من: a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم. ﴿افْتَرى﴾ past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by على; [the two] attached to the verb افترى. ﴿كَذِباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). And the clause ﴿أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِآياتِهِ﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause ﴿لا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ; and the clause ﴿إِنَّهُ لا يُفْلِحُ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. يوم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «remember». ﴿نَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾ imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «we». ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا﴾ للذين is attached to (mutaʿalliq) نقول; the clause نقول is conjoined to نحشرهم, and so like it is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and the clause أشركوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَيْنَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adverb, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿شُرَكاؤُكُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation, and the mīm is for the plural; and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as an adjective of شركاء. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is its noun and the clause ﴿تَزْعُمُونَ﴾ its khabar; and the clause كنتم تزعمون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The two objects of تزعمون are omitted, because what precedes them indicates them, i.e. «you claimed them to be partners».

daas-irab:101-101.t: ﴿بَدِيعُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "Allah is the Originator". ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿أَنَّى﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَكُونُ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, nominative with ḍamma. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of walad; it was an adjective (ṣifa) of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَدٌ﴾ the fāʿil (agent), nominative. It is also possible to parse ﴿يَكُونُ﴾ as incomplete (nāqiṣa), with the preposition and its genitive noun lahu as its khabar. ﴿وَلَمْ تَكُنْ﴾ an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿صاحِبَةٌ﴾ its postponed noun, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl; the clause ﴿أَنَّى يَكُونُ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ the khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ before it are attached, and ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is circumstantial.

daas-irab:102-102.t:
﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance, the kāf for address and the mīm for the masculine plural. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, first khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ second khabar. ﴿لا إِلهَ﴾ lā is the lā of generic negation, and its khabar is omitted; إله is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of the implied pronoun in the omitted khabar.
The clause lā إله إلا huwa is a third khabar. ﴿خالِقُ﴾ a fourth khabar. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is itself muḍāf. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاعْبُدُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition), the implied form being "if Allah is your Lord, the Creator of everything, …"; ﴿اعبدوه﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the mubtadaʾ, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَكِيلٌ﴾ the khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it, ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾, are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the nominal clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:103-103.t: ﴿لا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصارُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); lā is negating, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصارَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause ﴿وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿الْخَبِيرُ﴾ a second khabar.

daas-irab:104-104.t: ﴿قَدْ جاءَكُمْ بَصائِرُ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent), and ﴿قَدْ﴾ is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بصائر, or to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ man is a jussive-making conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿أَبْصَرَ﴾ a past verb, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَلِنَفْسِهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "then his seeing is for himself"; the implied nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), after the linking fāʾ, and the clause ﴿من أبصر﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَمَنْ عَمِيَ فَعَلَيْها﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of the one before it, and the clause is conjoined to it. ﴿وَما﴾ the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَنَا﴾ a nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of mā. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar after them. ﴿بِحَفِيظٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿حفيظ﴾ is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of mā, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:105-105.t:
﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "We vary the signs with a varying like that varying". ﴿نُصَرِّفُ الْآياتِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil (agent) being latent, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلِيَقُولُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to an omitted, implied element: "so that they may reflect and so that they may say". ﴿دَرَسْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُ﴾ like ليقولوا. The interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the implied maṣdar: "so that they may reflect, and so that We may make it clear". ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of qawm.

daas-irab:106-106.t: ﴿اتَّبِعْ ما﴾ an imperative verb and a relative noun, its object; its fāʿil (agent) is "you", and the clause is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "sent down from your Lord". ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to the clause اتبع.

daas-irab:107-107.t:
﴿وَلَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted:
"their guidance"… The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما أَشْرَكُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and mā is negating, with no governing effect; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَما جَعَلْناكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظاً﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the kāf is its first object and حفيظا its second object, to which the preposition and its genitive noun عليهم are attached (mutaʿalliq); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ﴾ like وما ana عليكم بحفيظ.

daas-irab:108-108.t:
﴿وَلا تَسُبُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "worshipped besides Allah". ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَيَسُبُّوا اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; يسبوا is an imperfect verb conjoined to تسبوا, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the Name of Majesty its object, and the clause is conjoined; the fāʾ may also be the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya) that makes the verb accusative. ﴿عَدْواً﴾ a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached to عدوا. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition; dhā is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "We have made their deeds attractive to the disbelievers with a making-attractive like Our making their deed attractive to every nation". ﴿زَيَّنَّا ...﴾
﴿عَمَلَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَرْجِعُهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿كَذلِكَ زَيَّنَّا﴾ before it. ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, the hāʾ is its object, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ mā: maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them: "then He will inform them of their deeds". The clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:109-109.t: ﴿وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿جَهْدَ﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative. ﴿أَيْمانِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is a jussive-making conditional particle. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ آيَةٌ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil, and the inceptive clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath [Translator's note: so in the source; it is ﴿لَيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِها﴾ that is the answer to the oath]. ﴿لَيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِها﴾ بها: the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿إِنَّمَا الْآياتُ﴾ الآيات is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and إنما is the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the verbal clause qul is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the wāw is resumptive. The clause ﴿يُشْعِرُكُمْ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of mā. ﴿أَنَّها﴾ anna and its noun, and the clause of إذا and what it governs is in the position of the nominative as its khabar. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive. ﴿جاءَتْ﴾ the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the clause ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause of anna, its noun and its khabar is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:110-110.t: ﴿وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is "we" (نحن); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَبْصارَهُمْ﴾: conjoined (ʿaṭf). ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle), and together with the verb ﴿لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾ it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the kāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "We turn their hearts and their eyes, a turning like their distance from faith." ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the preceding verb. ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to the preceding verb. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is "we" (نحن). The clause ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause نذرهم is conjoined to the clause نقلب أفئدتهم.
