daas-irab:111-111.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّنا﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿نَزَّلْنا إِلَيْهِمُ الْمَلائِكَةَ﴾: a past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), with its fāʿil (agent); الملائكة is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and نا is its noun. Anna with its noun and its khabar is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "our sending down became clear" (تبين إنزالنا). ﴿وَكَلَّمَهُمُ الْمَوْتى﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; الموتى is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَحَشَرْنا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; كل is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُبُلًا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿ما كانُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوا﴾: يؤمنوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. The implied an and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the implied sense being: "they were not deserving of faith". The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of كانوا. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ يَشاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَجْهَلُونَ﴾: lākinna is a particle resembling the verb; أكثرهم is its noun, and the clause يجهلون is its khabar. The nominal clause ولكن أكثرهم is resumptive.

daas-irab:112-112.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ذا is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the kāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) explained by what follows, the implied form being: "We made for every prophet a making like that making which We made for you, of enmity". ﴿جَعَلْنا لِكُلِّ﴾: a past verb, and نا is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿نَبِيٍّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَدُوًّا﴾: its second object. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from عدوا, because it has been placed before it. [Translator's note: the source glosses ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ twice as written; the second gloss, a ḥāl from عدوا, refers to the same phrase لكل نبي.] ﴿شَياطِينَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْإِنْسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْجِنِّ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يُوحِي بَعْضُهُمْ إِلى بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the preceding verb, and ﴿الْقَوْلِ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غُرُوراً﴾: a ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The clause ﴿يُوحِي﴾ is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of عدوا, or a ḥāl from الشياطين. ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما فَعَلُوهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ما is negating; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb) of لو. ﴿فَذَرْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ذرهم is an imperative verb, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿وَما يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: ما is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the following verb as a maṣdar conjoined to the accusative pronoun before it; the implied form is: "so leave them and their fabrication". It is also permissible for ما to be a relative noun, likewise conjoined to the hāʾ. The clause فذرهم has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the implied condition.

daas-irab:113-113.t:
﴿وَلِتَصْغى﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl); the sign of its accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because it is impossible to pronounce. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to غرورا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to تصغى before them. ﴿أَفْئِدَةُ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وَلِيَرْضَوْهُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to what precedes it and is in the position of genitive by the lām. Likewise ﴿وَلِيَقْتَرِفُوا﴾. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُقْتَرِفُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:114-114.t: ﴿أَفَغَيْرَ﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle. غير is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; the implied form is: "Shall I seek other than Allah as judge?" ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَكَماً﴾: tamyīz (specification) or ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَبْتَغِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ to the implied clause of speech: "Say to them, O Muhammad: Shall I incline to the embellishments of speech, and so seek a judge other than Allah?" ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), so the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl. ﴿أَنْزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكِتابَ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مُفَصَّلًا﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is the clause يعلمون. ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ الْكِتابَ﴾: a past verb; نا is its fāʿil, the hāʾ its first object and الكتاب its second object; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّهُ مُنَزَّلٌ﴾: anna, its noun and its khabar, which have taken the place of the two objects of يعلمون. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: attached to منزل. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl from the latent pronoun in the passive participle منزل. ﴿فَلا تَكُونَنَّ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); تكونن is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā before it. Its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). ﴿مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of تكونن. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition: "if that is the case, then do not be…".

daas-irab:115-115.t: ﴿وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive after the wāw. ﴿صِدْقاً﴾: tamyīz (specification), or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or ḥāl (circumstantial) by interpreting it in the sense of "truthful" (صادقا). ﴿وَعَدْلًا﴾: conjoined to ﴿صِدْقاً﴾ and like it. ﴿لا مُبَدِّلَ﴾: lā is the lā of generic negation; مبدل is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿لِكَلِماتِهِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾: a second khabar.

daas-irab:116-116.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يُضِلُّوكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object. الله, the name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
﴿إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and الظن its object; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), إن is negating; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction and إن is negating; هم is a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يخرصون is its khabar (predicate). The nominal clause هم يخرصون is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:117-117.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿هُوَ﴾ may also be parsed as a detached nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ its khabar, the nominal clause هو أعلم being the khabar of inna. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "He knows best who goes astray" (هو أعلم بمن يضل). ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb يضل. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: khabar. ﴿بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ﴾: attached to أعلم.

daas-irab:118-118.t: ﴿فَكُلُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); it points to an implied condition made clear by what follows: "if you are truly believers, then eat of that over which the name of Allah has been mentioned". ﴿كلوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِمَّا﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; اسم is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and الله, the name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ بِآياتِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar مؤمنين. The clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the implied form is: "if you are believers in His signs, then eat".

daas-irab:119-119.t:
﴿وَما لَكُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ما; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَلَّا تَأْكُلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and لا is negating, without governing effect. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by a preposition, the implied form being: "What is with you in not eating?" The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of ما. ﴿مِمَّا ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is اسم. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause ذكر اسم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of ḥāl. ﴿ما حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. [Translator's note: the source writes ﴿أَلَّا﴾ here; the Quranic word is ﴿إِلَّا﴾.] ﴿مَا اضْطُرِرْتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿اضْطُرِرْتُمْ﴾: a passive past verb; the tāʾ is its nāʾib fāʿil, and the mīm marks the plural. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: attached to the verb before them; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ كَثِيراً لَيُضِلُّونَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause يضلون is its khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the nominal clause وإن كثيرا is resumptive. ﴿بِأَهْوائِهِمْ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl, the implied form being "clothed in lack of knowledge" (متلبسين بغير علم). ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
﴿بِالْمُعْتَدِينَ﴾: attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) أعلم. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:120-120.t: ﴿وَذَرُوا ظاهِرَ الْإِثْمِ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, with its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الإثم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَباطِنَهُ﴾: conjoined to ظاهر. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ الْإِثْمَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿سَيُجْزَوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿بِما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿كانُوا يَقْتَرِفُونَ﴾: kāna and its noun, and the clause يقترفون is its khabar; the clause كانوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:121-121.t: ﴿وَلا تَأْكُلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined by the wāw to the clause وذروا ظاهر الإثم وباطنه. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿لَمْ يُذْكَرِ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive by lam, and اسم is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: attached to يذكر; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or conjunctive, or resumptive; and each parsing carries a legal ruling regarding everything over which the name of Allah has not been mentioned, on which the jurists and mujtahids have differed. «[Note: ﴿وَإِنَّهُ لَفِسْقٌ﴾ — فسق (transgression): is it the act of the legally responsible person, i.e. neglecting to mention the name [of Allah] or mentioning a name other than Allah's? Or is it the slaughtered animal over which the name was not mentioned? Is the omission through forgetfulness or deliberate? Because of conflicting reports, the mujtahids held three views on the ruling of mentioning the name: First: it is obligatory without qualification; this is the view of the Ẓāhirīs, Ibn ʿUmar and Ibn Sīrīn. Second: it is obligatory when one remembers and lapses when one forgets; this was held by the Mālikīs, the Ḥanafīs and al-Thawrī. Third: it is an emphasised sunna; this was held by al-Shāfiʿī and his followers. See the Tafsīr of al-Qurṭubī, Bidāyat al-Mujtahid of Ibn Rushd, and others.]» ﴿وَإِنَّهُ لَفِسْقٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنَّ الشَّياطِينَ﴾: inna and its noun; the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause ﴿لَيُوحُونَ إِلى أَوْلِيائِهِمْ﴾ is its khabar; the lām is the shifted lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿لِيُجادِلُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the mīm marking the plural. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يوحون. ﴿وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُمُوهُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is joined to the tāʾ of the agent; the tāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as fāʿil; and it [the verb] is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The mīm is for the masculine plural, and its ḍamma has been lengthened so that it became a wāw, for euphony. The hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُونَ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar; the lām is the shifted lām; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the fāʾ has been omitted from it because the condition is in the form of the past.

daas-irab:122-122.t:
﴿أَوَمَنْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw is a conjunction. من is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ مَيْتاً﴾: kāna and its khabar (predicate); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فَأَحْيَيْناهُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; نا is its fāʿil (agent) and نورا its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is conjunctive, so the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: the source attaches نورا to this verb as written; in the verse نورا is the object of the following verb جعلنا, as the next gloss itself states.] ﴿وَجَعَلْنا لَهُ نُوراً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَمْشِي بِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun. ﴿فِي النَّاسِ﴾: attached to the verb before them, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil: "he walks by it, illumined, among the people". ﴿كَمَنْ﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and ﴿مَنْ﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿مَنْ﴾. ﴿مَثَلُهُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الظُّلُماتِ﴾: attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَيْسَ بِخارِجٍ مِنْها﴾: in بخارج the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; خارج is a noun genitive in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar of laysa; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). ﴿مِنْها﴾: attached to the active participle خارج; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the relative noun. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "it has been made fair-seeming to the disbelievers, a making-fair like the making-fair of the believer's deeds". ﴿زُيِّنَ لِلْكافِرِينَ ما﴾: a passive past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:123-123.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: its parsing is as given in the previous verse, i.e. "just as We made in your people the great ones of its criminals, likewise…". ﴿جَعَلْنا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي كُلِّ﴾: its second object. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَكابِرَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مُجْرِمِيها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the nūn has been dropped for the iḍāfa, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِيَمْكُرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to يمكروا. ﴿وَما يَمْكُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ما is negating and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: attached to يمكرون. ﴿وَما يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: the clause is resumptive or conjoined.

daas-irab:124-124.t: ﴿وَإِذا جاءَتْهُمْ آيَةٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is a conditional adverb, non-jussive; [جاءتهم is] a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and آية is its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause after it is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the verbal clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the clause is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَتَّى نُؤْتى﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; نؤتى is a passive imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن), and it is the first object. ﴿مِثْلَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُوتِيَ رُسُلُ اللَّهِ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil, and the name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; the verbal clause ﴿يَجْعَلُ رِسالَتَهُ﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَيُصِيبُ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object. ﴿أَجْرَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿صَغارٌ﴾ is the fāʿil of يصيب, and the sīn is for the future; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿أَجْرَمُوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾: an adverb of place attached to سيصيب. ﴿وَعَذابٌ شَدِيدٌ﴾: conjoined to صغار. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb after it, ﴿كانُوا﴾, is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of their plotting"; the clause ﴿يَمْكُرُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:125-125.t: ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: من is a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿يُرِدِ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of من. ﴿أَنْ يَهْدِيَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb after it is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied form being "his guidance" (هدايته). ﴿يَشْرَحْ﴾: an imperfect verb, the jussive apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لِلْإِسْلامِ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿صَدْرَهُ﴾: its object; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). ﴿وَمَنْ يُرِدْ أَنْ يُضِلَّهُ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ﴾: its parsing is like the preceding one. ﴿ضَيِّقاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of the verb يجعل. ﴿حَرَجاً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿كَأَنَّما﴾: [ka-anna] restrained [by mā] and the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), without governing effect. ﴿يَصَّعَّدُ فِي السَّماءِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from صدره. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "Allah places defilement upon those who do not believe, a placing like the placing of the disbeliever's breast". ﴿يَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted second object, and الرجس is its first object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:126-126.t: ﴿وَهذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh); ذا is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿صِراطُ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُسْتَقِيماً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿فَصَّلْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْآياتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb فصلنا. ﴿يَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم.

daas-irab:127-127.t: ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿دارُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿السَّلامِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl, after the wāw of ḥāl. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the active participle وليّهم. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun, and the clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is its khabar. The clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:128-128.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time for an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر). ﴿يَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ويوم يحشرهم is conjoined. ﴿يا مَعْشَرَ﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and معشر is a one addressed (munādā) in construct. ﴿الْجِنِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِ اسْتَكْثَرْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl, and the vocative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنَ الْإِنْسِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to استكثرتم. ﴿وَقالَ أَوْلِياؤُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ الْإِنْسِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl from أولياؤهم. ﴿رَبَّنَا﴾: a one addressed in construct. ﴿اسْتَمْتَعَ بَعْضُنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾ are attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of speech. ﴿وَبَلَغْنا أَجَلَنَا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿أَجَّلْتَ لَنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿النَّارُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَثْواكُمْ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the object of speech, and the clause قال النار مثواكم is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: a ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to خالدين. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: a second khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:129-129.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. كذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being: "We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others, an alliance like the bringing down of punishment upon mankind". It is also permissible to parse the kāf as a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "the matter is like the making of some wrongdoers allies [of others]". ﴿نُوَلِّي بَعْضَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object; the fāʿil (agent) is "we" (نحن), and ﴿بَعْضاً﴾ is its second object. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ. ﴿بِما كانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ﴾: like بما كانوا يعملون, verse 127.

daas-irab:130-130.t:
[Translator's note: in the source text of this entry the brackets around the Quranic words are corrupted and the first letter of each word is lost (e.g. «ا» for يا, «َعْشَرَ» for معشر); the Quranic words are restored below from the verse.]
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مَعْشَرَ﴾: a one addressed (munādā) in construct, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿الْجِنِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْإِنْسِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined); the vocative clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "it will be said to them" (يقال لهم). ﴿أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter because it ends in a weak letter; the kāf is its object. ﴿رُسُلٌ﴾: its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رسل; the clause ألم يأتكم is likewise the object of speech of an omitted verb. ﴿يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿آياتِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the yāʾ of the speaker is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a second adjective of رسل. ﴿وَيُنْذِرُونَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿لِقاءَ﴾: second object. ﴿يَوْمِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive as an adjective; the clause is conjoined. The clause قالوا is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿شَهِدْنا عَلى أَنْفُسِنا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; نا is its fāʿil; the clause is the object of speech. ﴿وَغَرَّتْهُمُ﴾: a past verb and its object; the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾: its fāʿil. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective; the clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَشَهِدُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to شهدنا. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿كافِرِينَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative with the yāʾ. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna with its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by an omitted preposition, the implied form being: "they bore witness to their being disbelievers". The clause of kāna with its noun and its khabar is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna.

daas-irab:131-131.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is what follows, i.e. "that is confirmed"; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the matter is that". ﴿أَنْ﴾: lightened from the heavy [anna]; its noun is omitted, the implied form being أنه. ﴿لَمْ يَكُنْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn. ﴿رَبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ﴾: its noun and its khabar. ﴿الْقُرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِظُلْمٍ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to مهلك, or to the latent pronoun in it. The lightened an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive (majrūr) by an omitted preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك. The nominal clause ﴿وَأَهْلُها غافِلُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of ḥāl.

daas-irab:132-132.t:
﴿وَلِكُلٍّ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿دَرَجاتٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: ما is relative or maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive (majrūr) by min; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of درجات. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs like laysa. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: its noun. ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; غافل is a noun genitive in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar of ما; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial.
﴿عَمَّا﴾: like مما, i.e. ما is relative or maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by عن; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to غافل, and the clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:133-133.t:
﴿وَرَبُّكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ربك is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْغَنِيُّ﴾: first adjective (ṣifa). ﴿ذُو﴾: second adjective, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿الرَّحْمَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ﴾: إن is a jussive conditional particle; يشأ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and يذهبكم its apodosis (jawāb); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. It is also permissible for الغني to be a first khabar, ذو a second khabar, and the clause a third khabar. ﴿وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِكُمْ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb before them. ﴿ما يَشاءُ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined, and the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَما أَنْشَأَكُمْ﴾:
the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb after it is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar. ﴿مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿قَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾: an adjective, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:134-134.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as its noun. ﴿تُوعَدُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَآتٍ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آت is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ. The clause إن ما توعدون لآت is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ما is the Ḥijāzī mā. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: its noun. ﴿بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; معجزين is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of ما, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause وما أنتم is conjoined.

daas-irab:135-135.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾: a one addressed (munādā) in construct, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb اعملوا; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative. ﴿إِنِّي عامِلٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for what precedes it, and the clause ﴿فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is likewise causal, confirming what precedes it; the fāʾ before it is a particle of causation and سوف is a particle of the future. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَكُونُ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لَهُ عاقِبَةُ﴾: عاقبة is the noun of تكون, placed after, and the preposition and its genitive noun له are attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:136-136.t:
﴿وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from نصيبا, because it has been placed before it. ﴿ذَرَأَ﴾: a past verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْحَرْثِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl from [نصيبا]. ﴿وَالْأَنْعامِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿نَصِيباً﴾: likewise. [Translator's note: the source text here is compressed: «متعلقان بمحذوف حال من ﴿وَالْأَنْعامِ﴾ عطف ﴿نَصِيباً﴾ أيضا»; it evidently means that من الحرث is a ḥāl from نصيبا, that والأنعام is conjoined, and that نصيبا is the mafʿūl bihi.] ﴿فَقالُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿هذا﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هذا, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِزَعْمِهِمْ﴾; similarly ﴿هذا لِشُرَكائِنا﴾. ﴿فَما كانَ﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of consequence (tafrīʿ); ما is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لِشُرَكائِهِمْ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar of كان. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because of the conditional sense in the relative noun; لا is negating, and the clause ﴿لا يَصِلُ إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of inna. [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no inna here — the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما.] ﴿وَما كانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ إِلى شُرَكائِهِمْ﴾: the clause يصل إلى شركائهم is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو. ﴿ساءَ﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as fāʿil; or in the sense of "a thing", indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as tamyīz (specification), with the fāʿil a latent pronoun; the implied form being: "evil is the judgment, as a judgment, their judgment". The clause of the imperfect ﴿يَحْكُمُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun or an adjective (ṣifa) of ما.

daas-irab:137-137.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "their partners made fair-seeming to many of the polytheists the killing of their children, a making-fair like that making-fair in their polytheism", making fair what has passed. ﴿لِكَثِيرٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them, and من المشركين is attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of كثير. ﴿قَتْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. ﴿أَوْلادِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شُرَكاؤُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil (agent) placed after; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِيُرْدُوهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to زيّن. ﴿وَلِيَلْبِسُوا﴾: like يردوا; an imperfect verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and ﴿دِينَهُمْ﴾ its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the name of Majesty is its fāʿil; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما فَعَلُوهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ما is negating; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَذَرْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); an imperative and its object, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or of accompaniment (maʿiyya); ما is a relative noun or maṣdariyya, i.e. "leave them and their fabrication". ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:138-138.t:
﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿هذِهِ أَنْعامٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). ﴿وَحَرْثٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿حِجْرٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of أنعام and حرث.
﴿لا يَطْعَمُها﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَنْ﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of يطعمها. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِزَعْمِهِمْ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in قالوا: "they said, clothed in their claim". ﴿وَأَنْعامٌ﴾: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "and these are cattle"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُها﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as an adjective of أنعام. Likewise ﴿وَأَنْعامٌ﴾ after it is conjoined, and the clause ﴿لا يَذْكُرُونَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا﴾ is likewise in the position of nominative as an adjective. ﴿افْتِراءً﴾: a ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ are attached to it. ﴿سَيَجْزِيهِمْ بِما كانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: something similar has been given before.

daas-irab:139-139.t:
﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي بُطُونِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ما. ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْأَنْعامِ﴾: badal (substitute), genitive (majrūr). ﴿خالِصَةٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of ما. ﴿لِذُكُورِنا﴾: attached to خالصة. ﴿وَمُحَرَّمٌ﴾: conjoined to خالصة. The nominal clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى أَزْواجِنا﴾: attached to محرّم before them. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.
﴿مَيْتَةً﴾: its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); هم is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيهِ شُرَكاءُ﴾: its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿سَيَجْزِيهِمْ﴾: the sīn is for the future. ﴿يجزي﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its first object and ﴿وَصْفَهُمْ﴾ its second object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ﴾: inna, and the hāʾ is its noun, and ﴿حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ are its two khabars. The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:140-140.t:
﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَسِرَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, and the verbal clause ﴿قَتَلُوا أَوْلادَهُمْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَفَهاً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in قتلوا. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَحَرَّمُوا ما﴾: a past verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the relative noun its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَزَقَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb; the hāʾ is its object and الله, the name of Majesty, its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿افْتِراءً عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: ḥāl or mafʿūl li-ajlihi; the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it. ﴿قَدْ ضَلُّوا﴾: the clause is an emphasis (taʾkīd) of the first clause قد خسر. ﴿وَما كانُوا مُهْتَدِينَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined, and ما is negating, without governing effect.

daas-irab:141-141.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْشَأَ جَنَّاتٍ﴾: a past verb and its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مَعْرُوشاتٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَغَيْرَ﴾: a noun conjoined to معروشات; it is muḍāf, and ﴿مَعْرُوشاتٍ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالنَّخْلَ وَالزَّرْعَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿مُخْتَلِفاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿أُكُلُهُ﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of the active participle مختلف. ﴿وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالرُّمَّانَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿مُتَشابِهاً﴾: a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿وَغَيْرَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مُتَشابِهٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كُلُوا مِنْ ثَمَرِهِ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb, non-jussive; the clause ﴿أَثْمَرَ﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَآتُوا﴾: an imperative verb like كلوا, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿حَقَّهُ﴾: its first object; its second object is omitted, its implied form being "the needy" (المحتاجين). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to آتوا. ﴿حَصادِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا تُسْرِفُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and لا is negating; the clause ﴿لا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ is the khabar of inna, and the clause إنه لا يحب المسرفين is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:142-142.t:
﴿وَمِنَ الْأَنْعامِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "and He created of the cattle". ﴿حَمُولَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb.
﴿وَفَرْشاً﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كُلُوا مِمَّا﴾: an imperative verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; it is indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, and the clause ﴿رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خُطُواتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra. ﴿الشَّيْطانِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from عدو: it was an adjective of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl.
﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:143-143.t:
﴿ثَمانِيَةَ﴾: badal (substitute) from حمولة, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿أَزْواجٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الضَّأْنِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from اثنين; it was an adjective of it before being placed ahead of it. ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾: badal from ثمانية. ﴿مِنَ الْمَعْزِ اثْنَيْنِ﴾: likewise. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "you" (أنت); the clause is resumptive. ﴿آلذَّكَرَيْنِ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and الذكرين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before the verb ﴿حَرَّمَ﴾.
﴿أَمِ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ﴾: a conjoined noun, accusative with the yāʾ because it is dual; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أم﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, conjoined to الأنثيين. ﴿اشْتَمَلَتْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ are attached, and ﴿أَرْحامُ﴾ is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ. ﴿نَبِّئُونِي﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn because it is joined to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its object. ﴿بِعِلْمٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The conditional clause has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:144-144.t: ومن الإبل اثنين، ومن البقر اثنين …: the parsing of something similar was given in the previous verse. ﴿أَمِ﴾: a conjunction in the sense of بل ("rather, were you witnesses"). ﴿كُنْتُمْ شُهَداءَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to شهداء. ﴿وَصَّاكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهذا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the kāf is its object and ﴿اللَّهُ﴾, the name of Majesty, its fāʿil (agent). The clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause كنتم is conjoined. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ is its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾: attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) أظلم. ﴿افْتَرى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِيُضِلَّ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, "for misleading"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb افترى, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: attached to افترى. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ is its khabar; ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause إن الله is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:145-145.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb. ﴿لا أَجِدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is "I" (أنا), and لا is negating, without governing effect. ﴿فِي ما﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb أجد.
﴿أُوحِيَ﴾: a passive past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and ﴿مُحَرَّماً﴾ is its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause لا أجد is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). [Translator's note: as worded, «مفعوله» follows the gloss on أوحي; محرما is the object of أجد.] ﴿عَلى طاعِمٍ﴾: attached to the passive participle محرّم, and the clause ﴿يَطْعَمُهُ﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as an adjective (ṣifa) of محرّم. [Translator's note: so in the source; a genitive adjective here would qualify طاعم, not محرّم.] ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ يَكُونَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); its noun is "it" (هو) and its khabar (predicate) is ﴿مَيْتَةً﴾. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ دَماً مَسْفُوحاً أَوْ لَحْمَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿خِنزِيرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَإِنَّهُ رِجْسٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar; the fāʾ is for causation, and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ فِسْقاً﴾: conjoined to لحم. ﴿أُهِلَّ﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِهِ﴾ are attached; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لِغَيْرِ﴾. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اضْطُرَّ﴾: a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil being "he" (هو). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿باغٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). ﴿وَلا عادٍ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the fāʾ falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); inna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition, and the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) with its apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar of من.

daas-irab:146-146.t:
﴿وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb placed after, حرمنا. The clause after it, ﴿هادُوا﴾, is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿حَرَّمْنا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ذِي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns.
﴿ظُفُرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنَ الْبَقَرِ﴾: attached to حرّمنا. ﴿وَالْغَنَمِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿حَرَّمْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿شُحُومَهُما﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and mā is for the dual. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the excepted. ﴿حَمَلَتْ ظُهُورُهُما﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَوِ الْحَوايا﴾: conjoined; and likewise ﴿أَوْ مَا اخْتَلَطَ بِعَظْمٍ﴾. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جَزَيْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object.
﴿بِبَغْيِهِمْ﴾: attached to the verb before them; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The clause ذلك جزيناهم is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّا لَصادِقُونَ﴾: inna, and نا is its noun, and صادقون its khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).
The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of ḥāl, or it is resumptive.

daas-irab:147-147.t:
﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كَذَّبُوكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive.
﴿فَقُلْ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذُو﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿رَحْمَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿واسِعَةٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا يُرَدُّ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative; لا is negating, without governing effect. ﴿بَأْسُهُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿عَنِ الْقَوْمِ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to يرد. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾: an adjective, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ. The clause لا يرد is conjoined.

daas-irab:148-148.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb, the sīn being for the future; the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿أَشْرَكُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لَوْ﴾ is a non-jussive conditional particle; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). The clause ﴿ما أَشْرَكْنا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is negating. ﴿آباؤُنا﴾: conjoined to the pronoun نا in the verb أشركنا. ﴿وَلا حَرَّمْنا﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; شيء is a noun genitive in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is conjoined to ما أشركنا. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): ﴿كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ "a denial being [like that]". The verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the verb ﴿ذاقُوا﴾ and the an implied after حتى is in the position of genitive by the preposition: "until their tasting" ﴿بَأْسَنا﴾. [Translator's note: so in the source; an is not normally implied before a past verb after حتى.] ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿عِنْدَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ عِلْمٍ﴾: من is a redundant preposition, and علم is a noun genitive in form and nominative (marfūʿ) in position as a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is the object of speech. ﴿فَتُخْرِجُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); تخرجوه is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to what precedes it: "Is there with you knowledge, and so a bringing-out?" ﴿لَنا﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِنْ تَتَّبِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الظَّنَّ﴾: its object. ﴿إِنْ﴾: negating, without governing effect; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿تَخْرُصُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause وإن أنتم إلا تخرصون is conjoined.

daas-irab:149-149.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلِلَّهِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it points to an implied condition: "if you have no proof, then to Allah belongs the conclusive proof". ﴿لله﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate): "the conclusive proof belongs to Allah". ﴿الْبالِغَةُ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فَلَوْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهَداكُمْ﴾: the lām falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); هداكم is a past verb and its object. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

daas-irab:150-150.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative, its fāʿil (agent) being "you" (أنت). ﴿هَلُمَّ﴾: a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) in the sense of "bring" (احضروا), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you (pl.)" (أنتم).
﴿شُهَداءَكُمُ﴾: its object; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ﴿يَشْهَدُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: anna, and the name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿حَرَّمَ﴾ after it is its khabar (predicate), its fāʿil being "He" (هو). ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna, its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb يشهدون, i.e. "to the forbidding of this". ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a jussive conditional particle, and the past verb ﴿شَهِدُوا﴾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). [Translator's note: so in the source; شهدوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis is فلا تشهد, as the next gloss states.] ﴿فَلا تَشْهَدْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā; the fāʾ connects the apodosis; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مَعَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb before it. ﴿وَلا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْواءَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is "you" (أنت); the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a conjoined relative noun. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾: attached to the verb after them. ﴿يَعْدِلُونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:151-151.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَعالَوْا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَتْلُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), by the dropping of the weak letter; the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its object. ﴿حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and ربكم is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا﴾: an is the accusative-governing particle; [تشركوا is] an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from ما حرم, and لا is negating, without governing effect. ﴿وَبِالْوالِدَيْنِ﴾: a noun, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is dual; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "do good" (تحسنوا). ﴿إِحْساناً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and أولادكم its object. ﴿مِنْ إِمْلاقٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them; the clause is conjoined. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿نَرْزُقُكُمْ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause نحن نرزقكم is causal (taʿlīliyya) or resumptive. ﴿وَإِيَّاهُمْ﴾: conjoined to the kāf in نرزقكم. ﴿لا تَقْرَبُوا الْفَواحِشَ﴾: لا is prohibitive, and [تقربوا is] an imperfect verb in the jussive, with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما ظَهَرَ مِنْها﴾: a past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the relative noun ما is in the position of accusative as a badal from الفواحش, and the clause after it is its ṣila. ﴿وَما بَطَنَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ﴿حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). [Translator's note: the source writes ﴿أَلَّا﴾ here; the Quranic word is ﴿إِلَّا﴾.] ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in تقتلوا, i.e. "in the state of your being clothed with right". ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the kāf is its object and the mīm marks the plural; the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: لعل, and the kāf is its noun, and the clause تعقلون is in the position of nominative as its khabar. The clause لعلكم تعقلون is causal, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:152-152.t:
﴿وَلا تَقْرَبُوا﴾:
an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is preceded by the prohibitive lā; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and ﴿مالَ الْيَتِيمِ﴾:
mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and اليتيم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾:
a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالَّتِي﴾:
attached (mutaʿalliq) to تقربوا. ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾:
mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى﴾:
a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَبْلُغَ﴾:
an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the preposition حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are likewise attached to the verb. ﴿أَشُدَّهُ﴾:
mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ﴾:
an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَالْمِيزانَ﴾:
conjoined to الكيل. ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾:
attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of أوفوا. ﴿لا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْساً﴾:
an imperfect verb and its object; لا is negating, without governing effect. ﴿إِلَّا﴾:
a particle of restriction. ﴿وُسْعَها﴾:
second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or parenthetical.
﴿وَإِذا﴾:
a conditional adverb, non-jussive; the clause ﴿قُلْتُمْ﴾:
is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاعْدِلُوا﴾:
an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾:
the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ ذا﴾:
ذا is the khabar of kāna, accusative with the alif because it is one of the five nouns; the noun of kāna is omitted, its implied form being "the one judged against" (المحكوم عليه).
﴿قُرْبى﴾:
muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿بِعَهْدِ﴾:
attached to the verb أوفوا after them; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ذلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾:
its counterpart has been given earlier.

daas-irab:153-153.t:
﴿وَأَنَّ هذا﴾: anna, and the demonstrative is its noun, and ﴿صِراطِي﴾ is its khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker.
﴿مُسْتَقِيماً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb); the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَاتَّبِعُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اتبعوه is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ﴾: لا is prohibitive, and [تتبعوا is] an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتَفَرَّقَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); its original form is تتفرق; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdariyya an and the verb is conjoined to an implied maṣdar preceding it, the implied form being: "let there be from you following and no scattering". ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl, the implied form being "taking you far away from His path". ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ﴾: attached to the verb تفرق or to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿ذلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ﴾: its like has gone before.

daas-irab:154-154.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿آتَيْنا مُوسَى الْكِتابَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَماماً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb), or ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَى الَّذِي﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to تماما. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾: a past verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَفْصِيلًا﴾: conjoined to تماما. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾: attached to تفصيلا. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةً﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعل and its noun, and the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾: attached to the verb placed after, يؤمنون. The clause لعلهم بلقاء ربهم is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:155-155.t: ﴿وَهذا كِتابٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾: a past verb; نا is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its object; the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a first adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مُبارَكٌ﴾: a second adjective. ﴿فَاتَّبِعُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اتبعوه is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾: like اتبعوا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل, and the kāf is its noun. ﴿تُرْحَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعل, and the clause لعلكم is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:156-156.t: ﴿أَنْ تَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the implied form being "lest you say" (لئلا تقولوا); it is also said to be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the implied form being "out of dislike of your saying". The preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb أنزلناه. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: [inna] restrained [by mā] and the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أُنْزِلَ الْكِتابُ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلى طائِفَتَيْنِ﴾ are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِنا﴾: attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of طائفتين. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is lightened from the heavy [inna], without governing effect. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as its noun. ﴿عَنْ دِراسَتِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar (predicate) ﴿لَغافِلِينَ﴾. The lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa) between the governing inna and the lightened, non-governing in; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:157-157.t: ﴿أَوْ تَقُولُوا﴾: conjoined to the first تقولوا. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّا﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: a passive past verb to which the following preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and ﴿الْكِتابُ﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿لَكُنَّا أَهْدى﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the lām falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: attached to أهدى. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, the implied form being: "do not say that, for clear proof has come to you". ﴿جاءَكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the kāf is its object and بينة its fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾: its khabar. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) by min; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أظلم. ﴿كَذَّبَ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ are attached; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿وَصَدَفَ عَنْها﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿سَنَجْزِي الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the sīn is a particle of the future. ﴿يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ آياتِنا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿سُوءَ﴾: its second object. The clause is likewise the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause سنجزي is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna, and the wāw is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَصْدِفُونَ﴾ is its khabar. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb after it is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb نجزي, i.e. "We will requite them for their turning away from Our signs".

daas-irab:158-158.t:
﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle conveying negation. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: accusative-governing. ﴿تَأْتِيَهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: its fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
Likewise أو يأتي ربك and ﴿أَوْ يَأْتِيَ بَعْضُ آياتِ رَبِّكَ﴾; the implied form is: "do they await anything but the coming of the angels, or the coming of your Lord…", etc. ﴿آياتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ with ḍamma; as muḍāf ilayhi it is the رَبِّكَ of آيات ربك.] ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb placed after, لا ينفع. ﴿لا يَنْفَعُ نَفْساً إِيمانُها﴾: لا is negating, and [ينفع is] an imperfect verb, with its object and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause يأتي بعض is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, after the adverb يوم. ﴿لَمْ تَكُنْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of نفسا. ﴿آمَنَتْ﴾: a past verb, the tāʾ being for the feminine. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: من is a preposition; قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from the iḍāfa; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. The clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكن. ﴿أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمانِها خَيْراً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; خيرا is its object and the fāʿil is "she/it" (هي); the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿انْتَظِرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿مُنْتَظِرُونَ﴾: its khabar. The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
