daas-irab:159-159.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of inna. ﴿فَرَّقُوا دِينَهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَكانُوا شِيَعاً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَسْتَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar of laysa, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي شَيْءٍ﴾ are also attached to it. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: [inna] restrained [by mā] and the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَمْرُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is "He" (هو). ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition. ﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya (verbal-noun particle). ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna, and the wāw is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ is its khabar. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb ينبئهم. The clause ينبئهم is conjoined.

daas-irab:160-160.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿فَلَهُ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَشْرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ placed after. ﴿أَمْثالِها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis, and the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) with its apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis; لا is negating. ﴿يُجْزى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), and it is the first object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِثْلَها﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: لا is negating; يظلمون is a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of هم. The clause وهم لا يظلمون is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:161-161.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb. ﴿إِنَّنِي﴾: inna, and the yāʾ is its noun, and the nūn is for protection (wiqāya). ﴿هَدانِي﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because it is impossible to pronounce; the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبِّي﴾: fāʿil (agent), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb هداني. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause إنني is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause هداني is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿دِيناً﴾: badal (substitute) from the position of إلى صراط, which is originally the second object of the verb هداني, because هدى takes its object directly, as in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿اهْدِنَا الصِّراطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ﴾, or through a preposition, as in this verse. ﴿قِيَماً﴾: an adjective of دينا. ﴿مِلَّةَ﴾: badal from دينا. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa, a diptote because it is a proper name and non-Arabic. ﴿حَنِيفاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating. ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar of kāna; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:162-162.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ صَلاتِي﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيايَ وَمَماتِي﴾: conjoined. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبِّ﴾: badal (substitute) from the name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. The clause إن صلاتي is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl), a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

daas-irab:163-163.t: ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation, which governs like inna. ﴿شَرِيكَ﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the overt fatḥa. ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَبِذلِكَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the bāʾ is a preposition; ذا is a demonstrative, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb placed after, ﴿أُمِرْتُ﴾. The lām is for distance and the kāf for address. The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:164-164.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَغَيْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa; the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَبْغِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil (agent) is "I" (أنا). ﴿رَبًّا﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative.
﴿وَهُوَ رَبُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause أبغي is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كُلِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; لا is negating, without governing effect; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلَيْها﴾: attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb تكسب. ﴿وَلا تَزِرُ وازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; لا is negating; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُخْرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied on the alif because it is impossible to pronounce. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿إِلى رَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ placed after, ﴿مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil being "He" (هو), and the kāf its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم. The clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:165-165.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَعَلَكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the kāf is its first object, and ﴿خَلائِفَ﴾ its second object. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). ﴿وَرَفَعَ﴾: a past verb to which the adverb ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ is attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿بَعْضَكُمْ﴾: its object, and ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿دَرَجاتٍ﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition, [i.e.] "to degrees" (إلى درجات). ﴿لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the kāf is its object, its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يبلوكم. [Translator's note: so in the source; the lām phrase is normally attached to the preceding verb (رفع or جعل), not to يبلوكم itself.] ﴿فِي ما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the genitive; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the verb. ﴿آتاكُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the kāf is its object and the fāʿil is "He" (هو); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ الْعِقابِ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ is conjoined.
